source: Sungrow, Communication Protocol of Residential Hybrid Inverter V1.0.23 (TI_20211231)

sources.title: Communication Protocol of Residential Hybrid Inverter
sources.note: sections 3.1, 3.2 and appendix 1.1-1.3; document marked Public

notes: Addresses are the protocol addresses of the manual; the wire address is one less (address_base 1).
Read-only data are input registers (FC04); settings are holding registers (FC03/06/16). Input 5000 and holding 5000 are different registers.
32-bit values are sent low word first.
The 15-minute and daily/monthly/yearly history tables (6100-6826) are not listed here.
Newer firmware and models (SH-RT V2, SH-T) have more registers that this document does not cover.
